title: CRAFT DASH
oneLiner: Gather glowing scraps, craft tools, and outrun the wilds in a tiny arcade adventure.
mechanics: The explorer runs across a scrolling one-screen wilderness automatically.
Steer left and right to collect wood, ore, and crystal scraps.
Press A to craft a tool that clears the next obstacle or B to dash briefly.
Rocks, brambles, and beasts slow you down; speed and obstacle density ramp over time.

controls.a: Craft the best available tool and clear an obstacle

lose: Lose when an obstacle catches the explorer or the timer runs out of stamina.
scoring: Score points for gathering resources, crafting tools, and surviving longer.
note: SHRUNK THE OPEN WORLD RPG INTO ONE ARCAD
